images.prompt: Vertical cinematic film still, photorealistic, Central Asia mid-2000s, warm golden color grade, fine film grain. Keep the lower third darker and calm for text. No text, letters, numbers, logos, flags or watermarks. Faces not visible or in deep shadow. Only the described subject. close-up from the side. A tall skinny boy's hands pulling old worn red leather boxing gloves onto his hands, seen in side profile, inside a dusty old boxing gym with patched heavy bags hanging from chains behind him, light beams through dust. Anatomically correct arms and hands.
